1981-2415-6097-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6097-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

1395-4885-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

971-4687-6723.notablePrerequisites: Pentad Prism has at least four counters on it.
971-4687-6723.description:
Activate A Realm Reborn by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Pentad Prism, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1494-2527-3784-4247-4275.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding an amount of {C} equal to Vhal's toughness that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Haunted One triggers, causing Humans and Wizards you control to get +2/+0 and to gain undying until end of turn.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sage of Hours.
When Sage of Hours dies, its undying ability and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Sage of Hours trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Humans and Wizards.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

1170-5131-6495-7753--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6495-7753--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Valeria Richards.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-5131-6495-7753--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

394-3240-6462-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
394-3240-6462-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4247-4681-5170-7918.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1115-2457-4289-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

338-549-3197-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-549-3197-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

3532-3536-5078-7737.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2167-5626-5721-7705.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-5626-5721-7705.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Mole Man triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1170-2440-5115-7517.description:
Cast the copy of Aqueous Aria spell from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Campus Composer, which enters prepared.
When Campus Composer enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating a 3/3 Elemental creature token with flying.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Pay an additional {2}{U} to repeat steps 1 through 5 an additional time, this time adding {C}{C}{C} from the Mana Echoes triggers.
Pay an additional {1}{U} to repeat the loop again, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {U} to repeat the loop again, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {U} to repeat the loop again, adding six {C}.
Activate Gemstone Array by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat steps 1 through 5 and step 10 any number of times.
1170-2440-5115-7517.notes: Mana needed drops significantly for each additional Merfolk, Bard, and Elemental you control.

4997-7223-7414.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4997-7223-7414.description:
Draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-3861-3875-4231-6441.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3861-3875-4231-6441.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

628-2921-7217.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

628-6798-7214.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Glen Elendra Guardian.
When Glen Elendra Guardian dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

6072-6747-7182.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
6072-6747-7182.description:
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Sami.
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6835-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

49-1796-2034-4871-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

65-2546-2628-4652--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {0} due to Fluctuator and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Surly Badgersaur trigger.
Resolve Surly Badgersaur's ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding (1).
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Tilling Treefolk.
When Tilling Treefolk enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land and up to one additional land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
65-2546-2628-4652--38.notes: Since you can draw your entire library, discarding down to maximum hand size at end of turn will trigger Surly Badgersaur's abilities many times.

4968-6919-7061.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Solid Ground.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
4968-6919-7061.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

394-1580-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3497-3967-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3497-3967-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
3497-3967-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3497-3967-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2921-3602--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one of the two persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2921-3602--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1-2428-4067-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-2428-4067-6282.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

1987-2493-2556-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2493-2556-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Mnemonic Wall.
When Archaeomancer and Mnemonic Wall enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2493-2556-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2850-4050--71.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with persist, adding {1}.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Ivy Lane Denizen triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

851-2457-4365-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

3443-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Deathbloom Ritualist does not have summoning sickness. You have at least four creature cards in your graveyard.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Deathbloom Ritualist
3443-5200.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist
Repeat.
3443-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

939-4365-4404-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Corridor Monitor.
When the Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Soul Foundry and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

396-2034-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature.
396-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Blessed Sanctuary, creating a 2/2 Unicorn artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Unicorn, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
